_comment: Phone calls to Andy's office. 'requests' are what people ring with (add as many as you like). 'brushOffs' are what Andy says when he fobs someone off; 'ticketLines' when he says he'll sort it. Cold callers: names, pitches, hang-up lines and the lines when Andy hears them out.
requests: Can we book a kids' party for 40? Tomorrow. With a bouncy castle.
The council want to know why the pool is green.
Can you open the pool at 5am for the swimming club?
Has anyone handed in a set of false teeth?
Can my son have his party in the deep end?
We need you to fill in the 60-page safety audit. By lunchtime.
The bowling league wants new shoes. For free.
Is the sauna clothing optional? Asking for a friend.
Head Office wants a selfie of you smiling for the newsletter.
Can we run a foam party in the sports hall?
Someone's parked across all three disabled bays.
Can you do a zumba class? The instructor's off sick.
brushOffs: A problem, but not my problem.
Not my circus, not my clowns.
Put it in writing. In crayon.
I'll pass that on. To the bin.
ticketLines: I'll put it in the diary.
I'll get Sharon to sort it.
Fine. I'll look into it. Eventually.
coldCalls: Have you been in an accident that wasn't your fault?
We can halve your chlorine bill!
Your leisure centre may be eligible for free solar panels!
Can I interest you in 500 rubber ducks with your logo on?
Have you considered a wave machine? We do wave machines.
Our AI lifeguard never sleeps. Unlike yours.
Are you happy with your current broadband supplier?
Would you like to buy some Wegovy?
hearOutLines: Twenty minutes of my life. Gone.
I've agreed to a 'follow-up call'. Brilliant.
